content.text: {"answer":"10%","citations":["D041","D082","D065"],"explanation":"The signed 2026 QFL renewal (drafted 2026-03-02, signed March 20, effective April 1, 2026) sets the discount at 10% ($1,728 net on $1,920), so it applies on May 1, 2026.
